rounds.title: Quick Quiz
rounds.intro: Answer on your phone. Faster correct answers earn a little more.

questions.q: Which psalm begins “The Lord is my shepherd”?
questions.note: Psalm 23:1. Jesus called Himself the Good Shepherd (John 10:11).

questions.q: On the cross, Jesus quoted the opening line of which psalm?
questions.note: “My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?” (Psalm 22:1; Matthew 27:46)

questions.q: In Hebrew poetry, two or more lines that share connected ideas are called:
Proverbs 1:7 says this is the beginning of knowledge:
When Moroni first visited Joseph Smith in 1823, he began by quoting:
In 1836 Elijah appeared to Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery in this temple:
The Egyptian mummies the Saints bought in 1835 led to:
questions.note: The Book of Abraham, in the Pearl of Great Price

questions.q: Martin Harris showing characters from the gold plates to a scholar fulfilled:
Ava is anxious about choosing classes and a future career. The best passage for her:
questions.note: “Trust in the Lord with all thine heart…”

questions.q: Ethan made a serious mistake and wonders if Jesus Christ can forgive him. The best passage for him:
questions.note: “Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow”

rounds.title: Fake Out
rounds.intro: Your set writes a believable fake answer. Everyone else tries to find the real one. You score for every classmate you fool.

clues.prompt: “Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own ____.”
“They were of one heart and one mind, and dwelt in righteousness; and there was no ____ among them.”
“Who shall stand in his holy place? He that hath clean hands, and a ____ heart.”
Jacob gave Esau bread and ____, and Esau gave up his birthright.
Stephen met his wife, Jenn, on ____.
Troy played ____ on the BYU football team.

rounds.title: Sketch It
rounds.intro: Your set draws the same story. Everyone else guesses which story it is. Draw clearly, because you score when classmates guess right.

stories.story: Esau trading his birthright for a bowl of stew
Naaman washing seven times in the Jordan River
David facing Goliath with a sling and a stone
Elijah calling down fire on a water-soaked altar
Joseph fleeing and leaving his garment behind
Moses receiving the stone tablets on Mount Sinai
Ezekiel's two sticks becoming one in his hand

rounds.title: Never Forgotten
rounds.intro: Wager some or all of your points. Get it right to add your wager, miss it and you lose it.
rounds.q: The Lord said a mother might forget her nursing child, yet He will never forget us. “Behold, I have graven thee upon the ____ of my hands.”
rounds.note: Isaiah 49:16. The Savior's hands still bear the prints of the nails (3 Nephi 11:14–15).
